# Property — category guidance (auto-generated from live market data, 2026-08-26)

## Price sanity (NPR, live market data)
- Apartment Rentals: typically around 85,000/mo, most listings 50,000-185,000 (69 listings)
- House Rentals: typically around 200,000/mo, most listings 105,000-300,000 (56 listings)
- Land For Sale: typically around 2,000,000, most listings 1,200,000-15,000,000 (25 listings)
- Commercial Property Rentals: typically around 180,000/mo, most listings 40,000-375,000 (17 listings)
- Houses For Sale: typically around 2,200,000, roughly 1,800,000-37,500,000 (6 listings — thin data)
- Land Rentals: typically around 50,000/mo (5 listings — thin data, high end distorted by one outlier)
- Commercial Properties For Sale: wide spread ~850,000-42,000,000 (4 listings — thin data)

Sales here are high-value: a house or land "for sale" priced far below the low end (e.g. a Kathmandu house at 200,000) is a scam signal -> hold. But first check whether the price is per-unit (per aana/dhur) or a monthly rent mislabeled as sale — the title/description usually clarifies. Where n < 10, treat the band as indicative only and lean on general judgment.

## What good listings look like
- "House for rent at Lazimpat, Kathmandu"
- "Full-Furnished 3Bhk luxury Apartment For Rent!!📍Panipokhari, Kathmandu"
- "Land for Sale, Area १० धुर घडेरी"
- "Commercial space for rent at Maharajgunj, KTM"
- "5 aana Land For Rent !!📍Handigaun, Kathmandu"

A good listing names the property type, rent vs sale, a specific neighborhood + city, and size (BHK for apartments; aana/dhur/ropani for land) or furnished status. Nepali land units and Devanagari text are normal.

## Category-specific hold signals
- Duplicate of an already-live listing (same property, same seller, reposted) — this is the dominant real rejection reason in this category.
- Rent in a prime Kathmandu/Lalitpur area far below the band above, especially paired with urgency or a demand for advance/booking payment before viewing — classic Nepal rental scam -> hold.
- No identifiable location at all (not even a city/area) on a sale or rental listing — legitimate property ads here always name where the property is.
